dct_title_s: UNOSAT Live web map, M 7.7 Earthquake in Pitaloza Arriba, Panama – 9 October 2026, 17:56:06 UTC
dct_description_sm: **UNOSAT code: EQ20261011PAN** This application provides geospatial information from an ongoing satellite-based assessment of the magnitude 7.7 earthquake that occurred 12 km WSW of Pitaloza Arriba, Panama, on 9 October 2026 at 17:56:06 UTC. Important note: The boundaries and names shown, and the designations used on this map do not imply official endorsement or acceptance by the United Nations.
